escena: SCENE (Efeonce creative studio, Santiago, late afternoon): Julio is the real-life Professor, wearing a crisp warm-white shirt and his familiar glasses; Nexa, the real-life creative partner, wears her familiar neutral grey t-shirt. Both preserve their exact approved human identities and natural skin texture. Shoot from several steps back at eye level with a 50mm lens: both collaborators are waist-up, occupy the lower half of the composition, and the tops of their heads begin BELOW 39% of the frame height. Keep their complete faces uncovered and unobstructed; all of the upper 34% is clear warm-neutral wall for the comic title panel. A bold, deep, brushed-steel laboratory mixing bowl dominates the foreground on a real creative workbench. Julio looks toward camera with a half-smile, one hand poised above the bowl; Nexa stands beside him, looking into the bowl with a focused spark. Around the bowl are a small stack of real campaign photo proofs, paper color samples, a short written brief folded face down, and one contact sheet, all clearly physical ingredients for making a digital creative. The actual blue glass of the studio window creates a restrained azure reflection across one edge of the steel bowl; a vivid orange proof catches a narrow warm beam from the left. No blue backdrop. A decisive suspended instant: Julio has just dropped the orange proof into the bowl, the paper is mid-fall, other objects stay still. Dramatic but natural editorial photography, graphic hard-side light and deep textured shadows, three depth planes, shallow focus behind them, handcrafted real-world props, no fantasy magic. Medium-wide framing, hands and bowl prominent but never enlarge the faces. No cartoon, no costume, no franchise characters, no text, no logo, no bubbles or graphic effects in the photo; those are added by the editorial comic layout.
